# Components

Files marked `<auto-generated>` are generated by ComponentFlowExecutor.
**Do NOT edit them** — changes are lost on regeneration.

## Extending Generated Components

Use `.shared.cs` partial class files alongside generated code:

- `Button.shared.cs` extends the auto-generated `Button` partial class
- Add custom parameters, methods, and lifecycle overrides there

## Hand-Crafted Components

Some components are hand-crafted (no `<auto-generated>` header):
Icon, SelectInput, ComboInput — these are safe to edit directly.
